name: lazada_open_platform-mcp
display_name: Lazada Seller Center + Lazada Open Platform MCP
description: Lazada Seller Center + Lazada Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, g

platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_app_ke.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_app_ke.description: App Key of your Lazada Open Platform app (App Console).

platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_app_se.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_app_se.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API name (e.g. /order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value. Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_access.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_access.description: Seller access_token from the seller-authorisation code exchange (/auth/token/create). It expires (see expires_in); renew it with the signed system API /auth/token/refresh and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_domain.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_OPEN_PLATFORM_DOMAIN
platform_mcp_lazada_open_platform_domain.description: Country gateway of the seller's shop: sg, com.my, co.th, co.id, com.ph or vn → https://api.lazada.{domain}/rest (Service Endpoints on every API page).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GetSeller: the authorised seller (seller_id, name, short_code, status).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GetProducts: the AUTHORISED SELLER's own products (Lazada's open platform is seller-side), all statuses, 50 per page at most (offset up to 10,000). Price/SKU/stock are the FIRST SKU's, in the shop's local currency; `id` is the item_id for get_product. No keyword search (sku_seller_list matches whole Seller SKUs only).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GetProductItem: one product of the authorised seller by item_id; every SKU is in raw.skus.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GetOrder: an order RECEIVED by the authorised seller. `status` is the first of statuses[] (pending, ready_to_ship, shipped, delivered, canceled, …); `total` is the order price in local currency; `created_at` is '2014-10-15 18:36:05 +0800' style. Line items: /order/items/get (not mapped).

tools.name: track
tools.description: GetOrderTrace: one row per package with its tracking number and logistic_detail_info_list[{title, description, status_code, event_time (ms)}].
